name: Pink Shrimp Pasta

ingredients.name: Heavy cream (or Greek yogurt / light cooking cream)

steps: Cook the penne in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain, reserving a cup of pasta water.
In a large pan, heat olive oil and butter, sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add the shrimp, cook 2-3 minutes per side until pink, then remove and set aside.
Stir the marinara into the same pan, simmer 3-4 minutes.
Lower the heat, stir in the cream and parmesan until you have a smooth pink sauce.
Return the shrimp and drained pasta to the pan, toss to coat, loosening with pasta water if needed.
Season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Finish with fresh parsley.
notes: Freeze any leftover shrimp raw if not cooking within the shelf-life window.

flags.shelfLife: Shrimp — plan for days 1-3. Freeze the remainder if buying ahead.
